pieces.doc: Visual fill paired with `[forProgress]`. Reflects `data-state` and `data-percentage` so the consumer can drive width / transform from CSS.
Headless progress bar. Implements the [WAI-ARIA progressbar role](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#progressbar) for tasks whose completion is communicated visually.

inputs.name: max
inputs.doc: Maximum value. Defaults to `100` (so a raw value reads as a percentage).

inputs.name: getValueLabel
inputs.doc: Optional override for `aria-valuetext`. Useful for non-percentage progress (e.g. `"Step 3 of 5"`, `"42 MB of 200 MB"`). Receives the clamped value and current max.

inputs.name: announceCompletion
inputs.doc: When true, transitions to `value === max` are announced once via the live announcer using the current `aria-valuetext` (or `"Complete"` if none). Repeated transitions to the same complete state do not re-fire. The default is read from `provideForProgressDefaults` for the surrounding scope.

models.name: value
models.doc: Two-way bindable. Current progress in `[0, max]`, or `null` for the indeterminate state. Values outside the range are clamped for ARIA but the model retains what the consumer wrote.
